corrections.reason: RULES §3: `method` is the method's name alone. 'EFCI /Eh' is the table's column header (energy symbol plus unit), not a method name; the paper names the method FCI, and every other exact track-3 row uses 'FCI'. Value confirmed: Table I, row 'H10 1DChain', r = 1.00 Å, column 'EFCI /Eh' prints '−5.415393' in v2 and v1 alike; data release FCI_basis-STO6G.dat line '1.000    -5.415393'; QMBL pyscf FCI (fci/results.jsonl, Hchain/chain_10_O_R1.88973_sto6g) gives -5.415393318 Ha, |diff| = 3.2e-7 Ha, S^2 = 2.8e-13 (singlet). Stored eps -0.5415393 x 10 = -5.415393 Ha. R = 1.00 Å x 1.8897261 = 1.889726 bohr -> 1.88973. Geometry from chain_geom.py: 10 H atoms on z at ±r/2, ±3r/2, ..., ±9r/2 (equal spacing r, open chain). Nuclear repulsion included (agreement with the pyscf total, which includes E_nuc = 10.207660 Ha, to 1e-8). Basis STO-6G (Sec. III). Bound type exact (FCI in the basis) agrees with RULES §13.4. No other row on this instance in the track-3 pass file, the held file or data/ (data/Hchain does not exist): no duplicate.

corrections.reason: The paper is published in J. Chem. Phys. 153, 104108 (2020). gen/refs.mjs sets peer_reviewed from the DOI field of the arXiv API entry, and this arXiv entry carries no DOI or journal_ref, so the publication was missed. The same cause makes the row's evidence string say 'no journal version found' (gen/readers.mjs line 77); with peer_reviewed true it would say 'journal copy not reached', which is the true state on 2026-10-24.
